definition.title: Get your product taught in the courses that pick students' tools
definition.description: For a product students could learn on: finds public courses that teach its job, ranks them by when the instructor next picks tools, and drafts a teaching kit and one note per course in your voice. Skips courses earlier runs already listed; nothing is sent.

teaching_job.title: What a student would use your product to do (optional)
teaching_job.description: The task in a course's own words, e.g. collect survey data on phones in the field. Leave empty to derive it from the Feature map and growth plan.

alternatives.title: What courses use for this today
alternatives.description: Competing tools, spreadsheets, paper forms, or doing it by hand. Leave empty to use competitors the project files name.

subjects.title: Subjects or programs to search
subjects.description: Leave empty to let the run pick from the job.

education_offer.title: What you can give instructors and students
education_offer.description: Free seats, a class plan, setup help. Leave empty if you have not decided.

prerequisites.reason: The Feature map says what a student would do with the product when teaching_job is empty, and grounds the teaching kit.
The growth plan names the audience and records hard no's such as no cold email, which withholds the notes.
A captured writing style guide shapes the notes to instructors.
